title: Changing a description is recorded at both locations with Changed at
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations, the test location and location B, so the change can be seen at both.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location and at location B under the same part number, with a description, description 1, so both share one Part Library entry.
  • Use a new description, description 2, that no part uses.
  • Start at the test location on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Replace the Description with description 2.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Type the new value in the Search box.
  5. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
  6. Pick location B in the location selector at the top right.
  7. Click Parts in the top bar.
  8. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  9. Type the new value in the Search box.
  10. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 2:

  • Under the field: "This also changes the description at 1 other location."

Step 3:

  • The save goes through.

Step 4:

  • Part A is listed with the new value.

Step 5:

  • The newest entry reads "Description updated | Original description:" followed by description 1, "| New description:" and description 2, with nothing after it.

Step 6:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 7:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 8:

  • Location B's Inventory page opens.

Step 9:

  • Part A is listed at location B with the new value.

Step 10:

  • The newest entry reads "Description updated | Original description:" followed by description 1, "| New description:" and description 2, followed by "| Changed at:" and the test location's name: it names the location where the change was made.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S10-R24: “A changed description writes "Description updated | Original description: {old} | New description: {new}" to the Part History of the part at every location that stocks it.”
  • S10-R25: “On the entries written at the other locations, the line ends with "| Changed at: {location}", naming the location where the change was made.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Description changed on a part other locations stock | "This also changes the description at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”
